avis.texte: Light weight, but does not absorb quickly. No fragrance. Very nice moisturizer!

My friend got me the sampler kit for this brand and I loved it. What really stood out to me the is the cream, it made my skin feel so soft and nourished. I have sensitive skin and felt like it even help calm it down.
This is my pm moisturizer that leaves me feeling hydrated but not greasy
Good for the autumn/spring weather. In the winter, I definitely needed something a bit stronger.

It is seriously SO NICE and funnctional enough to hold in hydration after a tret night… yet light and cool under my makeup. It's perfect! Never pills under sunscreen. This one rates with the more expensive ones for sure. This moisturizer will make you fall in love with k-beauty all over again!

Ive been using IT cosmetics confidence in a cream for years (on and off), and it has been my #1 moisturizer since college. However, i just got this product about 5-6 days ago and i can already feel/see the difference in my skin. This winter had been especially cold, which has caused my skin to be extremely dry and irritated. It has reduced the redness and dry patches on my skin within a few uses. Totally imoressed and I think it may be my new favorite.
I have used LOTS of moisturizers, and NOTHING works as well as this one. My dry skin feels super hydrated and soft. I am in love with this one!

This moisturizer really hits all the notes for me. No matter what state my skin is in, this cream will work its magic on just what I need. It does not have sticky residue and I can do my make up on top of it easily. I love this stuff and will use FOREVER.
I bought this to try it as a winter cream and it is perfect - it absorbs wonderfully and is thick for this winter cold that dries out my skin more than normally - highly recommend < 3

Glad to find this moisturizer because it keeps the skin hydrating in harsh dry winter environments. It is thicker than Birch Juice Moisturizing Cream but it also absorbs quickly and feels not too oily/greasy.

Visibly brightening as well, my skin looks gorgeous and feels soft for about 24 hours after use. I sometimes have to supplement with a thicker moisturizer but this has been fantastic for daily use. Has slightly faded my scars and the hydration helps reduce redness.

The dokdo cream feels hydrating on my skin. It feels thick in hand but once applied to the face, it smooths out and feels very refreshing. It doesn't feel heavy, feels just right. A little goes a long way.
I am so happy I found the Dokdo cream. It really helps hydrate my skin and is not greasy. It doesn't make me break out. I highly recommend for those with a dry complexion.
This moisturizer is perfect for the cooler months. It keeps my dry skin hydrated, has no scent, absorbs quickly. The jar will last a long time since a little bit goes a long way
Hydrating, helped to get rid of skin texture, doesn't lay on too thick
I use this cream as morning routine. Very good, whole day hydration. I have mixed skin and it works well for me. Good foundation for make up too.
I love everything about the consistency of this cream. Hydrating & moisturizing
I always use this moisturizer and fear the day it gets discontinued! I only use this one product and nothing else! Love it sm!
The cream is great for my skin. It makes me feel decently hydrated and it's smooth.
product not for me. it gave me fungal acne - pimples and redness all around my nose and cheeks, probably because it has shea butter. i use it for my hands now and it is moisturizing.
I've been using this cream at night. It keeps my skin wonderfully moisturized and leaves it feeling deeply nourished by morning.

This cream is a skin savior for me, especially after laser treatments or when my skin is irritated. It also works perfectly under my makeup foundation. I've already gone through three jars and will definitely keep repurchasing it! I'm so excited to see it's now available at Ulta, my favorite beauty store.
Love this moisturizer when my skin needs a little more hydration. Not super heavy, but thicker than the Birch Juice moisturizer. I have combination skin so I alternate between the two moisturizers.
This is my second time buying this cream, and it works so well. It's super gentle but leaves me feeling moisturized. I will definitely buy it again.

What kind of black magic? Will never let myself run out. It balances acneic skin with dryness, and it balances my skin when it's acneic and oily. I also have hypersensitive skin. After several years of trying *everything* (La Mer, Vintner's Daughter, LRP, Ialuset, etc.) this is it. It is not too heavy, it is not too light. For drier or oilier times, just adjust the amount. So thankful for the many collected samples I'd used to their last drop by the time it got to me.
Definitely good for moisturizing, makes my skin really soft and dewy. It does feel prettt heavy tho, and it kinda gives you thay weird sweaty feeling sometimes, but otherwise a great moisturizer
Amazing cream especially for my dry skin in the winter time! Hasn't broken me out and my skin stays hydrated the entire day regardless of wind, etc!

Since I started this new skin care routine, it gave me a significant excellent results. My skin was started to clear up, look healthy and glowy. I think I found my match that would help my skin look healthy and supple. I will continue to use this as my skin care necessity. Loving it.
I always come back to this moisturizer because of how hydrating it is and how it lasts all day. Whenever I try something new I breakout, but not with this!
Thick cream and does feel like it makes a difference for my dry skin. I've been using it almost daily and I've noticed a difference
Since using this cream day and night, my skin has improved immensely. I also use it on the tops of my hands and the skin has improved there as well. I absolutely LOVE this product for my skin!

This replaces three lotions I was previously layering to try to moisturize and I still had dry skin! My skin is hydrated and so happy! Little bit goes a long way and best of all it does not PILL if I over do it. It is working so well I can use half as much as I was in the beginning.

avis.titre: Moisturizing to use during the winter
avis.texte: I noticed a big difference using this at night over using the birch moisturizing cream. It's very hydrating and I works well over night. I have not tried this under makeup.
Works well as it has no scent and moisturizes dry skin. A little goes a long way, so the product lasts me around 4 months.
This is the most hydrated my skin has ever been! Will definitely order more!
I have dry skin and this cream really helps moisturize my skin! It's not harsh or too heavy.
Have been using this for a couple weeks and it makes my skin feel fresh and moisturized without that oily feeling like I felt with my other moisturizers.

I have dry sensitive skin and I've been struggling to find a good moisturizer that won't break me out or one that could hydrate my skin. I decided to give this one a try and it quickly became my favorite moisturizer! It's really hydrating and It doesn't break me out at all. It's also unscented which is a major plus for me because it's impossible to find a moisturizer without scent. Ever since I started to use round lab products my skin has improved a lot. I highly reccommend!!!!

This is pretty thick! I would recommend that if you have very dry or dry skin better for you I have combined skin and it was a little heavy for me personally but I would recommend this in the winter if your in an very dry environment or place!

i have very dry flaky type of skin and have been trying out so many different brands of moisturizers (american brands) but none of them worked. i decided to finally try korean skin care and i am so happy i did! this is the only cream that actually moisturizes my dry skin and i love that it's lightweight rather than a thick cream. although it's small and expensive, it's worth it and i will definitely be repurchasing when i run out :)
Love! The cream is thick but also feels lightweight on the skin. The serum is good at soothing bright red spots and helping with irritated spots.

This was surprising thick, but also smooth. A little does go a long way with this product. Just lightly gliding my finger on the surface was good to pick up enough for a portion of my face. It melted into the skin quiet easily that I could barely feel it was there. I definitely would recommend giving it a try.

I live in a very, very arid climate and it is really difficult to find a moisturizer than can stand up to it. After I tried the sample of this moisturizer, I had to buy the full size immediately. Moisture lasts all day and I wake up after 8 hours' sleep with my skin still feeling supple and moisturized. I'm back to buy my second jar. I can stop looking for moisturizers now; it's perfect!
So soothing, so moisturising, so good. will definitely buy again

I had received a sample for this moisturizer, the birch, and I had ordered the mugwort one. The mugwort one was more gel like and very absorbent. I thought that would be the best one for my skin since im hormonal acne prone, with oily skin. However, it just wasn't moisturizing enough for my skin. I've used the cerave cream but during the day it can be super thick for me. I thought I was at a crossroads bc then buttery thicker creams would leave my skin oily, and then the gel like ones would be absorbed super quick and it didn't feel moisturizing. When I tried the sample for the Dokdo Cream I was in awe. It was buttery smooth but not as heavy as others and super moisturizing! Atleast for my skin, my face was not oily at all by the end of the day, especially when applying sunscreen on top. I use it day and night currently and love how smooth it makes my face feel and how moisturized it is all day! So I returned my mugwort one and got the Dokdo one instead bc it works wonders for my skin!! Hopefully it's as awesome in the summertime too. :)!

My Honest Review: Everything arrived safely, undamaged, and nicely packaged! The cream also came with some gift samplers which was a nice surprise, overall, I really like this product and the quality of the service. It's deeply hydrating, I have dry skin and this works great to apply before makeup. It also has a very rich and creamy texture, so a little bit goes a long way! If you're looking at this product and you're interested; I'd definitely recommend purchasing it, it was definitely worth it for me! 💕
I love Round Lab I've had the cream for almost a week now & I love it . Unscented ( I have very sensitive skin), thick , & very moisturizing
Makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. I have dry skin so it's exactly what I needed.
I love the this product. Leaves my face hydrated and moisturized.

The lotion is great too, but I feel like the cream is the more useful of the 2 if you don't have super oily skin.
These products are amazing! I saw results in my skin within a week. It's been hard for me to reach for my other skincare products since I started using the Dokdo line.
This is a great moisturizing cream. My face always feels hydrated and moisturized after use.

I bought this for night time use only as I have oily skin. It leaves my skin feeling super hydrated the next morning and I do think my skin health has improved since using it consistently. I find it really thick/rich and would never use it during the day, but perhaps someone with very dry skin would like it. I also use the dokdo SPF during the day which I love!

I have dry sensitive skin and am always nervous to try new products because I am prone to allergic reactions. I tried this last night for the first time and did not have any issues. On the contrary, I woke up and my skin still felt amazing. The cream itself goes on so smoothly and feels extremely luxurious. I look forward to seeing the long-term results of this cream!
This moisturizer is SUPER GOOD, I have combination skin and it works wonders. I would try pairing it with the snail mucin essence.

This is amazing for nighttime! I have dry skin and am currently using retinol, and this product is great for keeping my skin soft and hydrated all night. Love that it has ceramides and other soothing/barrier repair ingredients.

The next morning I woke up with my skin around my eyes red and dry, looking similar to when I have an allergic reaction. The cream is very thick and unscented and feels nourishing but it reacted very poorly with my skin. Be careful if you have sensitive skin.
I have oily acne-prone skin and this cream did not break me out! It's thick enough to provide adequate moisture but does not feel too heavy. I love this product and have purchased it many times!

Overall great experience with this cream - absorbs well, leaves skin feeling really soft without residue, and super gentle, even on irritated skin. No clogged pores and have been using for a month. Plays well with sunscreen and makeup, no pilling. Skin has been happy and no acne - normally very prone.
Super smooth, silky and moisturizing. Koreans know to make to smell of their products subtle and smell nice

the product states it's a cream. i thought it'd be helpful for my normal/dry skin. however, after applying it to my skin, i realized my skin felt a little dry due to the gel texture of the "cream." i'd suggest this for anyone with normal/oily skin, but def not dry skin

avis.titre: Holy grail of my skincare routine
avis.texte: I have been trying to find a moisturizing cream that actually helps to repair my dry skin and this is IT. I stumbled upon this cream at my local Korean skincare store, and I decided to take a chance on it. Every other moisturizer would dry either dry my skin out and I would still have flakes after consistent use. I have been using the 1025 Dokdo cream every night for almost 2 months now, and i haven't seen a single flake. It's also one of the only moisturizers where I wake up and I can still feel the product on my skin…I don't think I'll ever find a better cream, and I know it's a perfect moisturizer going into the winter/cold seasons. The team that made this —- i'm your biggest fan. for real. 100/10!

This face cream was recommended by a friend and i love it. It's super creamy and feels thick on my face. Also doesn't have a smell. I have acne prone combo skin, usually oily in the tzone, but it hasn't made me break out. Not sure how this would work on oily skin since its thick but maybe the burch gel moisturizer will work better. Will be buying the dodko face wash next!
Super moisturizing cream! Leaves the face smooth without it feeling oily
So far using the item it has been wonderful. It's a very light cream and it leaves my face feeling smooth and moisturized.

I have oily skin that is also sensitive due to tretinoin use. I have tried various moisturizers since being on tret but they have all, by some degree, irritated my skin especially my cheeks. This moisturizer has been amazing in keeping my skin moisturized without any irritation! I was amazed when I first tried it as I expected some stinging as with my previous moisturizers but it applied so well without issues. Love this product and will be repurchasing.

let me start off by saying, that I used to be terrified of trying new creams because they would all clog my pores. After trying several products from RounLab I decided you know what? why not give this "heavier" cream a try despite my history with creams? Now let me tell you, THIS, THIS right here is MAGIC. I mean it. My skin barrier healed in two days, my pores never clogged up, and my skin just drank this UP like it never did before to any cream. I tried everything, but nothing worked like this did. I cannot thank RoundLab enough for giving us such trustworthy ingredients in their products as well because I truly believe that it was that, that saved my skin. I hope they continue to grow and stick to their mission in the future 🙏�

It is a rich cream full of ceramides (thus, good for skin barker but on the oily side). I use it in my PM routine before tretinoin. It really helps me to reduce irritation from the retinoid.

I have very sensitive skin that is also acne prone but this moisturizer has kept my skin soft and hasn't broken me out. If anything it's made my skin look better!! I had originally bought the mugwort moisturizer, but my skin was much too dry for that one and I was breaking out from the lack of moisture in my skin! (Not to say the mugwort one is bad, just not right for my skin type) Once I got this one my skin cleared up and has stayed clear since! Love it!

avis.titre: Get it you won't regret it
avis.texte: The most hydrating thing I've ever put on my face. The only moisturizer I'll be using from now on. Can't wait to try the rest of the Birch collection.

The reasons I find this a great product are: 1) I find my skin still soft and moist even if more than 12 hours have passed since I applied it. It doesn't always work that way with other moisturizers 2) I like trying out other products or switching it out here and there. Other products - even way more expensive ones - have failed in comparison to how moisturizing this cream is. I've switched it with Goodal, Isoi, Ahc, etc. Round lab wins, hands down 3) Sometimes, when I switch products around, I get bad breakouts. I go back to this and my skin calms down 4) Very mild. Check out the ingredients (cosdna)
My skin has been very dry lately, but the Dokdo cream has helped give it moisture and comfort. I would definitely recommend it
I like how this cream comes with a spatula. This cream would look like it would do really good in dryer weather or if you have dry skin. Love that the package has weight to it.

avis.titre: Best Moisturiser I have ever used
avis.texte: I would absolutely recommend this moisturiser, it is the best moisturiser I have ever used. It is the exact same product you can buy in Korea, a little more expensive than buying it there, but 100% worth it in my opinion, as Korean skin care is honestly the best. After using this moisturiser, my skin always feels amazing and the product works so well and lasts all day. It is really effective with a good skin routine and to use every morning and evening for the best results. As I have acne prone skin, I have noticed a massive difference using this product and I don't get as many spots after I started using this product alongside using a good face wash, toner, serum and then this moisturiser and SPF.
This is a very moisturising cream but does not feel heavy on the skin. I have dehydrated combo skin and love to use it at my night routine as my last step.

I have purchased this product 3 times already. I have combination/normal skin. One of the things I love about this cream is its consistency. It is more on the thicker side but still has a bit of that smooth gel-like texture. It is very neutral, hydrating, and moisturizing without being greasy or oily like most moisturizing creams. My skin has not broken out when using this cream. I love this brand and its other products such as sunscreens and cleansers.

Nice! I have been using the toner and lotion together for more than 6 months, so I also wanted to try the Dokdo lines cream. I previously read that the Dokdo toner, lotion, and cream were best when used together.
Good for dry skin in winter time. No fragrance very soft and creamy

My skin feels plump and bouncy after using, and very soothed. I love it and even use it on my kids' eczema because it has no irritating ingredients and is a great barrier cream.
This cream is very thick and hydrating. A little goes a long way. I have dry skin so I use this every morning and night and havent had any issues. I highly recommend. Ill definitely repurchase!

The cream is very moisturizing and good for dry skin. It acts as a barrier that locks in moisture from your skin. The cream is unscented and quite thick as well, perfect for dryer climates or seasons.
The texture of this cream is feeling heavy but easy to absorb into the skin. Its suited to use in the cold winter, or dry, sensitive skin. The jar packaging is lovely.
My skin feels healthier, smoother and more hydrated. It is definitely worth buying!
I love this cream for being hydrating but not heavy or sticky.. I would recommend!
